Markets.title: Anthropic pre-IPO credit facility set to climb past $10 billion
Markets.summary: AI startup Anthropic is expanding its pre-IPO revolving credit facility beyond $10 billion as multiple banks seek to participate ahead of its anticipated fall public offering. The company is preparing for its Wall Street debut following a significant surge in revenue.

Markets.title: Gaja Alternative Asset Management mobilises Rs 165 crore from anchor investors
Markets.summary: Gaja Alternative Asset Management raised Rs 165 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 550 crore initial public offering opening on Wednesday. The IPO proceeds will be used to fund debt repayment, new fund seeding, and general corporate needs, with shares listing on August 26.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank raises $650 million in debut dollar bond sale
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank raised $650 million in its first-ever five-year dollar bond sale. Strong investor demand from Asia and Europe allowed the bank to tighten its pricing and draw $2.1 billion in orders.

Markets.title: Sebi to soon float consultation paper on distribution framework for corporate bonds
Markets.summary: Sebi will soon release a consultation paper to refine the distribution framework and sales of corporate bonds. The initiative evaluates new distributor categories and leverages online platforms to expand retail investor access to privately placed debt.

Markets.title: Sakarni Plaster to invest Rs 450 cr on expansion; to set up 2 building material plants
Markets.summary: Sakarni Plaster plans to invest Rs 450 crore over the next two years to build new plants and expand existing manufacturing. The funds will come from internal accruals and bank loans to support rising demand for gypsum boards and paints.

Markets.title: US single-family housing starts slide in July
Markets.summary: U.S. single-family homebuilding declined in July due to high mortgage rates and a growing inventory of unsold homes. Despite this drop, permits for future single-family construction saw a slight increase.

Geo-Political.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
Geo-Political.summary: Russia has accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. In response, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has vowed to support Kyiv's defense.

Geo-Political.title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
Geo-Political.summary: An earthquake struck the historic Spanish city of Granada, injuring three people and damaging various buildings and vehicles. The world-famous Alhambra palace has temporarily closed as a result of the tremor.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian President Lula has praised a new oil discovery in the sea near the mouth of the Amazon River. Environmentalists have strongly criticized the exploratory drilling that led to this find.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
Geo-Political.summary: Lindsay Clancy's mother-in-law testified that Clancy begged for mental health help before killing her three children. Clancy admitted to the killings but pleaded not guilty by reason of postpartum psychosis.

Geo-Political.title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
Geo-Political.summary: The death toll from a ferry sinking on Lake Kariba has risen to 93 victims. This incident is officially recorded as Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster, while recovery operations remain ongoing.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistan's top court has ordered that imprisoned former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred from jail to a hospital. Khan has been serving time since 2023 on corruption charges that he claims are politically motivated.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the creator paying for advertising or traditional optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and simplify their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that enables users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content generation, the platform provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased its India GDP growth estimate for fiscal year 2027 to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia conflict, high inflation, a weakening currency, and sluggish capital expenditure still pose downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: To protect rural incomes from El Nino and a weak monsoon, the government is front-loading agricultural spending. Agriculture spending and fertilizer outlays have both more than doubled compared to last year.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research expects India to achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus in fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows totaling tens of billions of dollars.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the Southwest Monsoon's overall rainfall deficit has narrowed to 13%, erratic weather patterns have caused severe regional imbalances. These imbalances are hidden by extreme swings between intense deluges and prolonged dry spells.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the elimination of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) securing government contracts. This change could significantly ease financial burdens for MSMEs, which represented half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in fiscal year 2026.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS). While joblessness declined in rural areas, it increased in urban centers.

India.title: 2 MBBS Interns Sexually Harassed At Haryana Medical College, Accused Arrested
India.summary: Two female MBBS interns were sexually harassed in separate incidents on a Haryana medical college campus last week. Police arrested the accused following the assaults.

India.title: Foreigner On Mumbai-Delhi Train Sprays Fire Extinguisher, Dies During Probe
India.summary: A foreign national traveling on the Golden Temple Express from Mumbai to Delhi sprayed a fire extinguisher inside the train. The individual died while authorities were investigating the incident.

India.title: 5 Injured After Ferris Wheel Cabin Crashes At Lucknow Fair, 2 Critical
India.summary: Five people were injured, two critically, when a Ferris wheel cabin crashed at the Indiranagar Sawan Mahotsav in Lucknow. The accident occurred within the jurisdiction of the Ghazipur police station area.

India.title: NDTV Can Become India's Voice To World: Rahul Kanwal
India.summary: Rahul Kanwal stated that NDTV can serve as India's voice to the world. He also described the news network as the original pioneer of the country's digital ecosystem.

India.title: Over 2.07 Crore Voters Face SIR Exclusion In Maharashtra: Poll Body Data
India.summary: Data from the election body shows that over 2.07 crore voters in Maharashtra are facing exclusion under the ASDD category. The highest numbers of excluded voters are concentrated in districts such as Pune, Thane, and Mumbai Suburban.

India.title: US Envoy Sergio Gor To Meet Omar Abdullah During 2-Day J&K, Ladakh Visit
India.summary: US Special Envoy Sergio Gor is visiting Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh for two days. During his trip, he will meet with Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha.

General.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
General.summary: Russia has accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. In response, Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that the UK remains one hundred percent committed to supporting Kyiv.

General.title: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
General.summary: A newlywed British couple on their honeymoon and their Greek pilot died in a helicopter crash. The accident occurred on a Greek island.

General.title: PM says he's not embarrassed about hoax message exchange
General.summary: The Prime Minister communicated with someone posing as Donald Trump's chief of staff, Susie Wiles, via a hoax message exchange. He stated that he is not embarrassed about the incident.

General.title: How soon will the drought be over?
General.summary: Rain has recently returned to parts of the UK. It remains unclear whether this precipitation is sufficient to end the ongoing regional droughts.

General.title: Premier League chief says Fifa self-destructed over World Cup plan
General.summary: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has criticized Fifa president Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan. Masters stated that Fifa has harmed itself by pursuing this controversial strategy.

General.title: Earl Spencer to 'tell the truth' about his sister Princess Diana in new book
General.summary: Swan Song: Diana, My Sister is due to be released in the UK next month, nearly 30 years after she died.
